negative_failure_audit.method: per-condition replay of all 24 matched negatives

incidental_failures_found_and_repaired.problem: negative incurred budget_negative by purchasing at a paid unreliable venue, so it failed on money rather than on source arbitration
incidental_failures_found_and_repaired.repair: unreliable source moved to a free venue and the negative now recalls both sources before arbitrating wrongly

novelty_caveats.memory_conditioned_preference: introduces no new evidence type; novelty rests on memory-seed content (reliable/unreliable source tagging) and the arbitration rule
novelty_caveats.resource_budget_allocation: its only condition type absent from prior pools is the generic no_feasibility_violation; mechanism novelty rests on the affordability-breaking decoy parameterisation

evaluator_additions.service_after_recovery: new condition type: service evidence counts only when produced at or after an outage recovery instant and no later than an optional deadline
